{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Drawing → `uRebarLayerMarker`
{{% /callout %}}

Places a layer symbol on rebar based on its class, using up to 16 configurable class-list → symbol slots (8 shown under a "Top" tab, 8 under "Bottom" — a presentation split: all 16 are evaluated together, the Top rows before the Bottom rows, first match wins). That covers up to eight layers per face.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Class list 1–16** | Which rebar classes each slot matches (wildcards supported, e.g. `11*`). |
| **Symbol file / index** | Which symbol library and symbol to draw for a matching bar. |
| **Height / Colour / Position / Offset / Rotation** | Shared appearance for all the slots in a tab (Top or Bottom). |
| **Delete existing** | Removes any markers this plugin already placed before adding new ones. |
